sentences.text: In nineteen fifty-nine, the Soviets toured a moon rocket through Mexico City.
The CIA wanted to inspect it, but armed guards watched the hall night and day.
So they targeted the transport truck heading to the rail yard.
Agents secretly diverted the flatbed into a rented salvage yard.
In socks to leave no marks, they pried open the twenty-foot crate.
Under flashlights, they unscrewed one hundred and thirty bolts to reach the engine.
They photographed every stamp, measuring rockets twice as powerful as America's.
Before dawn, they forged the Soviet wire seal and screwed the crate shut.
At seven a.m., the Soviet guard arrived and never noticed a thing.
